title: The Sith return
description: Padmé reveals herself to be Naboo's Queen Amidala before a startled Boss Nass, finally winning the Gungan leader's confidence and a solid pledge of military support. As a spectacular battle with Trade Federation forces ensues on the planet's grassy fields, Jedi warriors Oui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi clash once again with Sith assassin Darth Maul. Their furious Lightsaber duel ends with the death of Jinn and the apparent killing of his slayer, Maul, by Kenobi. Federation ambitions on Naboo are finally foiled, militarily and politically, but the mysterious Darth Sidious continues his master plan of galactic control and conquest...with young Anakin Skywalker becoming his latest pawn.
